messages:
Ravi: Heads-up — Sara's birthday is Thursday 4/15. Quick poll: cupcakes / bagels / charcuterie? Reply with your pick.

Nina: Bagels please (vegan schmear ok).

Jon: Charcuterie but can we include some non-meat options?

Sara L.: wow you’re planning already! I’m remote that day but would love a virtual card :blush:

Kay: Cupcakes! I can bring gluten-free ones.

Ravi: Noted. @people-ops-bot create poll "Sara’s snack" with options: Cupcakes / Bagels / Charcuterie and set reminder to send virtual card link on Apr 14 9am.

people-ops-bot: Poll posted. Voting open 36h. Reminder scheduled: "Send Sara virtual card link" Apr 14 9:00am.

Jon: voted Charcuterie (with non-meat platter).

Nina: voted Bagels.

Kay: voted Cupcakes.

Ravi: Thanks all. Sara, if you have any preference or allergies lmk. I’ll collect $5 from remote folks for the e-card — link: https://pay.example/sara-bday (closing Apr 14 EOD).

Sara L.: Thanks everyone! message for card: "Happy birthday Sara! Zoom slice next week :)"
